ns2:section.sectionText: This section is NOT intended for Journalism Majors. Journalism majors need to register for AD9/39008. Course meets entirely online. Deadlines will be set, but students work through the course at their own pace within those deadlines. The final exam and project will be online in Compass. Students may see the syllabus for details.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Not intended for Journalism major(s) or minor(s).
